description: Upgrade postgrest with SSL addon in place. Closes the docker-compose/ssl/upgrade matrix cell. docker-compose-based apps use 'target_versions=<image>=<tag>' (not oci_image_tag) because the upgrade pipeline exposes the version via DOCKER_postgrest_TAG env var to docker-compose. Source is postgrest/ssl-prev (pinned one release behind via compose_tag_overrides) so this is a real old->new upgrade; target must equal the versions.sh pin — the upgrade-version-pins unit test enforces both. stack_name='ssl-prev' keeps the upgrade in its source's stack so postgres credentials stay consistent.
